Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. 

 GET TO KNOW US 

 At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

 We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

 Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! 

 

 THE OPPORTUNITY 

 We are hiring a AI Operations Senior Manager to our Wellz team in São Paulo! 

 Wellz by Wellhub is our corporate mental health platform, delivering measurable, science-backed results for companies and their employees. By combining technology with human expertise, Wellz offers personalized journeys including online therapy, group sessions, interactive content, and 24/7 specialist chat support. Through data-driven insights and strategic dashboards, we also empower HR leaders to monitor wellbeing, boost engagement, and demonstrate ROI, making quality mental health support accessible and scalable.

 In this role, you will lead how Wellz rebuilds its own operations around AI from the ground up. This is not an AI-evangelist or data-infrastructure role. Wellz's leadership recently asked a blunt question: if we restarted Wellz today with AI as a given, which workflows would we actually build? You will own the answer, function by function—redesigning how teams run their core motions with AI agents doing the work by default, and humans stepping in only for judgment, negotiation, or clinical/legal exceptions.

 Reporting directly to Wellz's Head of Strategy & Operations, you will also represent Wellz inside Wellhub's company-wide AI direction, translating corporate mandate into ground-level execution. You will be building the playbook, not inheriting one, as Wellz actively expands across multiple markets including Europe.

 

 YOUR IMPACT 

 
 Workflow Refounding: Pick the next Wellz workflows to rebuild around AI (following the default-agent model) and define ownership, success metrics, and kill or graduation criteria for each.

 AI Program Ownership: Own Wellz's side of Wellhub's company-wide AI transformation program, translating corporate direction into actionable plans and reporting progress up to executive leadership.

 Adoption & Behavior Change: Drive hands-on operational adoption with target teams to build trust and ensure teams actually run on AI workflows, rather than keeping them as slide designs.

 Build vs. Buy Judgment: Evaluate and decide whether to build in-house solutions or adopt external vendor tools, defending decisions with rigorous data and clear ROI.

 Executive Narrative: Own the communications layer for Wellz and Wellhub C-levels, articulating what is live, what is in pilot, and what was sunsetted and why.

 Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

 
 WHO YOU ARE 

 
 Based in São Paulo — hybrid model.

 Proven track record of actually shipping an AI agent or workflow into production (not just prototypes), with technical comfort in tooling to test and iterate independently.

 Ability to identify true operational bottlenecks (cycle time, conversion, volume) and prioritize workflow rebuilds based on evidence rather than novelty.

 Strong bias to action, high tolerance for iterating in public, and the comfort to rework solutions rapidly based on real-world feedback.

 Ability to build trust and drive operational change across Revenue, Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Clinical Ops, and Transformation without direct line hierarchy.

 Ability to thrive without a fixed scope in a fast-evolving environment where priorities adapt as the AI-native operating model matures.

 Mandatory requirement to interface with Wellhub's global AI leadership.

 
 We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team.

 

 WHAT WE OFFER YOU 

 With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. 

 Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

 Our benefits include: 

 WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

 WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content. 

 HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance. 

 FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office. 

 FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

 PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

 PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled. 

 CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

 CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 

 Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube ! 

 

 Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub 

 We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. 

 Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

 Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here. 

 Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos.

About the Role
We are looking for a Presales Technical Consultant – Big Data & Databricks who combines strong technical expertise in modern data platforms with excellent client-facing and presales capabilities.
In this role, you will serve as a key technical bridge between our sales teams, global clients, and delivery organizations. You will lead the technical aspects of the presales lifecycle—from business and technical discovery, solution architecture, estimation, and proposal development to Proof of Concept (POC) and delivery handover.
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience delivering Databricks and large-scale data engineering projects, a strong understanding of modern cloud data architectures, and proven experience working with global enterprise clients and distributed teams.
I. Customer Discovery & Solution Design


 Lead technical and business discovery sessions with enterprise clients to understand their business objectives, existing data landscape, technical challenges, and transformation priorities.

 Translate business requirements into scalable big data, data engineering, analytics, and cloud data platform solutions .

 Design end-to-end solution architectures covering areas such as:

 Data ingestion and integration

 Data lake and lakehouse architecture

 Batch and real-time data processing

 Data transformation and orchestration

 Data modeling and analytics

 Data governance, security, and access control

 Cloud data platform modernization and migration

 Design solutions leveraging Databricks and related cloud data services across AWS, Azure, or GCP.

 Assess clients' existing data platforms and recommend practical modernization and migration approaches based on business value, technical feasibility, scalability, and cost.


 II. Technical Presales & Solution Demonstration


 Develop and present tailored solution proposals, architecture designs, and technical demonstrations based on specific client requirements and industry scenarios.

 Communicate both high-level business value and detailed technical solutions to different audiences, including C-level executives, business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams.

 Lead technical responses for RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs , ensuring proposed solutions are technically sound, commercially competitive, and aligned with client requirements.

 Lead or support Proof of Concept (POC) and technical validation activities to demonstrate solution feasibility and business value.

 Conduct technical workshops, architecture discussions, and solution review sessions with global clients.

 Support effort estimation, technical scope definition, assumptions, dependencies, and delivery planning during the presales process.


 III. Presales Project Management


 End-to-End Presales Management: Own the technical presales lifecycle from requirements discovery and solution architecture through proposal submission and delivery handover.

 Multi-Opportunity Management: Manage multiple client opportunities at different stages and prioritize activities based on deal value, strategic importance, complexity, and deadlines.

 Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate closely with Sales, Delivery, Engineering, Cloud, Data, and Project Management teams to develop feasible and competitive solutions.

 Bid & Proposal Management: Lead technical activities throughout the bid process, including requirements analysis, solution architecture, estimation, compliance review, risk identification, and final submission.

 Handover Management: Ensure a smooth transition from presales to implementation teams, with clear documentation of scope, architecture, assumptions, dependencies, risks, and client expectations.


 IV. Global Client Engagement & Technology Leadership


 Work directly with global enterprise clients , collaborating across different regions, cultures, and time zones.

 Build trusted technical relationships with client architects, engineering leaders, data teams, and senior stakeholders.

 Work effectively with distributed and cross-functional teams across different countries and regions.

 Partner with internal Engineering, Delivery, Product, and Business teams to identify reusable solution patterns, accelerators, and best practices.

 Provide technical enablement and knowledge sharing to sales, presales, and delivery teams.

 Stay current with developments in Databricks, cloud data platforms, lakehouse architecture, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML technologies .

 Contribute to the development of reusable reference architectures, solution frameworks, technical assets, and industry-specific offerings.
Education: Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

 Professional Experience


 6+ years of experience in data engineering, solution architecture, technical consulting, or presales roles, with significant experience designing complex enterprise data solutions.

 Proven experience working in a technical presales, solution architecture, or client-facing consulting role .

 Hands-on project experience with Databricks , preferably involving production-scale implementations rather than only training, certification, or POC environments.

 Experience designing or delivering large-scale data engineering, data lake, lakehouse, or cloud data platform solutions .

 Proven experience working directly with global enterprise clients , including technical workshops, solution discussions, presentations, and stakeholder management.

 Experience collaborating with distributed delivery and engineering teams across multiple regions.


 Technical Skills


 Strong understanding of modern big data and data engineering architectures .

 Strong hands-on knowledge of Databricks , including key concepts such as:

 Delta Lake

 Lakehouse architecture

 Spark-based data processing

 Data pipelines and orchestration

 Databricks SQL

 Unity Catalog and data governance

 Strong understanding of data ingestion, ETL/ELT, batch and streaming processing, data modeling, and data integration patterns.

 Experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform .

 Familiarity with cloud-native data services, data warehouses, object storage, messaging, orchestration, and analytics technologies.

 Understanding of enterprise data governance, security, access control, data quality, and compliance principles.

 Familiarity with APIs, integration patterns, and modern data ecosystem components.

 Ability to design scalable, secure, reliable, and cost-effective enterprise data architectures.


 Presales & Project Management Skills


 Proven experience managing technical activities throughout the presales lifecycle, from discovery and solution design to proposal and delivery handover.

 Strong experience with RFP/RFI/RFQ responses, bid management, solution estimation, and technical proposal development .

 Experience leading technical workshops, architecture reviews, and POCs.

 Ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities simultaneously.

 Strong ability to identify solution risks, assumptions, dependencies, and technical trade-offs.


 Communication & Influence


 


 Excellent verbal and written English communication skills , with the ability to work effectively with international clients and teams.

 Strong presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability to connect technical solutions to business outcomes.

 Confident engaging with stakeholders at different levels, from engineers and architects to senior management and C-level executives.

 Ability to simplify complex technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

 Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and influencing skills.
Experience with Databricks Data Intelligence Platform in large-scale enterprise environments.

 Databricks certifications such as Databricks Certified Data Engineer, Data Engineer Professional, or related certifications .

 Experience with multiple cloud platforms, particularly AWS and Azure .

 Experience with technologies such as Apache Spark, Kafka, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, or similar modern data platforms.

 Experience in enterprise data platform modernization or migration programs.

 Understanding of AI/ML, Generative AI, and their integration with enterprise data platforms.

 Familiarity with data privacy and compliance frameworks such as GDPR and CCPA.

 Experience working in consulting, system integration, or global technology service organizations.

 Relevant cloud certifications from AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or Databricks.

jobs.title: [job-32314] Developer Cloud (Python) Mid Level, Brasil.

jobs.description:
Na CI&T , ajudamos grandes empresas a transformar o potencial da AI em impacto real nos negócios com AI Deployment, execução AI-native e tech-integrated business solutions.
Com 30 anos de experiência em transformação tecnológica, aceleramos inovação com expertise em agentic SDLC, application modernization, Data & AI, martech e business strategy. 
Somos 8.000 CI&Ters em mais de 25 países, colaborando para construir soluções com impacto real. AI já faz parte da forma como trabalhamos, evoluímos e inovamos todos os dias.
Importante: se você reside na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequencia vigente.


Buscamos uma pessoa Sênior Fullstack com sólida base técnica e paixão por construir sistemas de alta escala. Você será protagonista na evolução da nossa arquitetura, garantindo que nossas soluções sejam resilientes, seguras e prontas para o futuro.
Nesta função, esperamos que você não apenas escreva código de excelência, mas que atue como referência técnica, utilizando Inteligência Artificial para otimizar o ciclo de desenvolvimento e elevando a barra de qualidade do time.
Responsabilidades:
Projetar, construir e evoluir serviços backend em Kotlin (Spring), APIs REST/gRPC e integrações via Kafka/SQS.
Construir e manter interfaces web em Next.js + React + TypeScript, seguindo as boas práticas do chapter frontend.
Atuar de ponta a ponta: da descoberta com produto ao deploy em produção, passando por revisão de código, testes e monitoramento.
Garantir qualidade com testes (unitários e de integração), CI/CD e cobertura.
Instrumentar e observar as entregas (métricas, logs, tracing) — nada vai para produção sem telemetria.
Colaborar cross-squad, realizar code reviews com rigor e elevar o nível técnico do time com mentoria de pessoas pleno/junior.
Requisitos para este desafio:
Experiência sólida como pessoa desenvolvedora fullstack com perfil sênior.
Backend: domínio de Kotlin (ou Java com forte vontade de migrar para Kotlin) — APIs, modelagem e boas práticas de arquitetura (Clean/Hexagonal, DDD).
Frontend: experiência com Next.js + React + TypeScript (SSR/SSG, data fetching, estilos, acessibilidade).
Cloud e infra: vivência com AWS (ou equivalente), contêineres e CI/CD.
Fluência em testes automatizados e cultura de qualidade.
[Opcional] Diferenciais:
Experiência prévia com foodtech, pagamentos ou fintech.
Kotlin + Spring Boot (ou Ktor) em produção.
Next.js App Router, Server Components e edge rendering.
Observabilidade (Datadog), SLOs e on-call.
Arquitetura orientada a eventos (Kafka) e sistemas de alta escala.
Modelagem relacional/NoSQL e/ou mensageria (Kafka/SQS).

#LI-midsenior

Experiência com microsserviços, design de APIs RESTful escaláveis e padrões de integração backoffice-to-backoffice.
Experiência com mensageria e Event-Driven Architecture: Google Cloud Pub/Sub e/ou AWS SNS/SQS, incluindo conceitos de ordenação de eventos, fan-out e DLQ.
Experiência com GCP e Kubernetes/GKE; desejável conhecimento complementar em AWS.
Familiaridade com API Gateway (Kong ou equivalentes).
Conhecimento em ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento (ex.: Dynatrace).
Familiaridade com uso de ferramentas/agentes de IA no dia a dia de desenvolvimento.
Conhecimento em práticas de DevSecOps e automação de CI/CD.

Buscamos alguém com sólida base em Java e arquitetura de software, visão de negócio e capacidade de construir relações de confiança com diferentes stakeholders.
Principais responsabilidades
Liderança Técnica e de Pessoas
Atuar como referência técnica para os times de engenharia, apoiando decisões e direcionamentos.
Orientar e desenvolver profissionais, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e evolução técnica.
Facilitar discussões, alinhamentos e resolução de problemas complexos.
Promover boas práticas de engenharia e compartilhamento de conhecimento.
Relacionamento com Clientes
Atuar como referência técnica junto às lideranças do cliente.
Conduzir reuniões, apresentações e discussões técnicas com diferentes públicos.
Compreender necessidades do cliente e traduzi-las em direcionamentos técnicos.
Alinhar expectativas, prioridades, riscos e dependências com clareza e transparência.
Construir relações de confiança, conduzindo conflitos e promovendo consenso entre stakeholders.

Apoiar a definição e evolução da arquitetura das soluções.
Avaliar alternativas técnicas e seus impactos para o negócio.
Orientar soluções utilizando Java, Spring Boot, APIs, microsserviços e integrações.
Apoiar decisões relacionadas a escalabilidade, segurança, performance e qualidade.
Identificar riscos técnicos e oportunidades de evolução.

Identificar oportunidades de aplicação de LLMs e outras tecnologias de IA.

Experiência como, Tech Lead, Senior Software Engineer ou posições similares.

Conhecimento de práticas de engenharia de software e CI/CD.
Experiência ou conhecimento em IA Generativa e integração com LLMs.

Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com clareza e segurança.

Capacidade de adaptar a comunicação para públicos técnicos e executivos.
Habilidade de influência, negociação e construção de consenso.
Escuta ativa, maturidade e habilidade para lidar com conflitos e diferentes perspectivas.
Experiência em liderança e desenvolvimento de pessoas.
Visão de negócio e capacidade de conectar decisões técnicas aos objetivos do cliente.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Backend Developer para atuar na evolução dos componentes core da AI Platform do CI&T Flow, com foco na orquestração de modelos, integração com provedores de LLM e construção de uma plataforma multi-cloud, observável, resiliente e escalável.

Atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções internas para o time de governança, com foco em ferramentas, automações e fluxos que sustentem as políticas de IA, controle de custos, conformidade e gestão de modelos da plataforma corporativa.
A posição terá atuação direta na criação e sustentação de aplicações voltadas para governança, exigindo proximidade com as demandas internas da equipe de governança, entendimento dos processos de controle e capacidade de projetar e implementar melhorias operacionais e sistêmicas. 
Essa pessoa será referência técnica na evolução da plataforma, atuando no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, decisões arquiteturais e resolução de problemas complexos. Buscamos alguém com sólida experiência em engenharia de software e sistemas distribuídos, além de conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial Generativa e arquiteturas baseadas em LLMs.

Desenvolver e evoluir os componentes core da AI Platform, incluindo governança de modelos, provedores, tenants e políticas de utilização.
Projetar e evoluir mecanismos de roteamento, load balancing, fallback e controle de consumo e custos de LLMs.
Desenvolver integrações com LiteLLM e diferentes provedores de modelos em ambientes de cloud pública.
Evoluir APIs, serviços e mecanismos de observabilidade, garantindo performance, disponibilidade, escalabilidade e confiabilidade da plataforma.
Investigar incidentes e problemas complexos em produção, identificando causas raiz e propondo melhorias estruturais.
Participar das decisões arquiteturais, avaliando trade-offs, riscos técnicos e impactos nos diferentes produtos consumidores da plataforma.
Atuar como referência técnica para o time, contribuindo para padrões de engenharia, boas práticas e evolução técnica das pessoas desenvolvedoras.
Colaborar com os times consumidores da plataforma no refinamento de soluções e resolução de problemas de integração.

Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Kotlin/Java e/ou Node.js.
Experiência com arquitetura e desenvolvimento de sistemas distribuídos, APIs e serviços de alta disponibilidade.
Experiência com cloud pública, Docker, Kubernetes e pipelines de CI/CD.
Conhecimento em LLMs e arquiteturas de aplicações baseadas em Inteligência Artificial Generativa.
Experiência com integração de modelos utilizando ao menos um dos principais provedores de LLM em cloud, como Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock ou GCP Vertex AI.
Conhecimento de mecanismos relacionados à operação de LLMs, como routing, fallback, streaming e gerenciamento de consumo.
Experiência com observabilidade e troubleshooting de sistemas distribuídos utilizando métricas, logs e traces.
Conhecimento de PostgreSQL e/ou MongoDB.
Conhecimento dos principais conceitos relacionados a RAG, AI Agents e Agentic AI.
Experiência em decisões técnicas e arquiteturais, atuando como referência técnica em ambientes de alta complexidade.

Experiência prática com LiteLLM e arquiteturas de AI Gateway, LLM Gateway ou Model Gateway.
Experiência com múltiplos provedores de LLM em ambientes de produção.
Conhecimento de MCP (Model Context Protocol).
Experiência com LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel ou frameworks similares.
Conhecimento de LLM Observability, utilizando ferramentas como Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus ou Grafana.
Conhecimento de vector databases, busca semântica e arquiteturas RAG.
Experiência com guardrails, segurança e controle de acesso em aplicações de IA.
Experiência com Helm, GitOps ou desenvolvimento de ferramentas e agents para AI Coding.

jobs.title: [Job-32167] Senior iOS Developer – AI, Brazil

jobs.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.
With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.
We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.


At CI&T, we are looking for a skilled and motivated Senior .NET Backend Developer to join one of our delivery teams.
You will design, build and evolve scalable, secure and maintainable backend services using a modern .NET stack, working closely with Product, Architecture, QA and Frontend colleagues in a collaborative, multicultural and fast-moving environment.
Your responsibilities
Design, develop and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services using C# and .NET 8+.
Apply Clean Architecture, SOLID and KISS principles to keep code modular, reusable and simple.
Build event-driven and asynchronous integrations using messaging platforms such as Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ or Kafka.
Model, query and optimize relational databases such as PostgreSQL and SQL Server, using Entity Framework Core.
Work with document databases such as MongoDB, when needed.
Implement secure authentication and authorization using OAuth2/OIDC and JWT.
Write and maintain automated unit and integration tests using tools such as xUnit, NSubstitute and Bogus.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, including Azure DevOps and YAML pipelines, and follow agreed branching strategies such as GitFlow.
Instrument services for observability, including structured logging, metrics and tracing, and help diagnose production issues.
Critically read, validate and review code, including code generated by AI tools, to uphold quality, security and performance standards.
Take part in code reviews, technical refinement and estimation, and help mentor less experienced developers.
Work with technical and non-technical stakeholders to turn requirements into pragmatic, maintainable solutions.
Requirements for this challenge
Solid experience as a backend developer working with C# and .NET, ideally .NET 8+, including production-grade RESTful APIs.
Strong knowledge of object-oriented design, SOLID principles, design patterns and Clean Architecture.
Hands-on experience with MediatR, AutoMapper and Entity Framework Core.
Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or SQL Server, including data modelling and query optimization.
Experience with distributed systems and messaging, using technologies such as Azure Service Bus, Rebus, RabbitMQ, Kafka or equivalent.
Practical use of AI tools in software development, such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, OpenAI APIs or similar, including AI-assisted code generation, testing and refactoring.
Experience building autonomous or semi-autonomous agents for software development, or knowledge of prompt engineering and evaluating AI output quality.
Experience with automated testing, including unit and integration testing and the use of test doubles.
Working knowledge of Docker and Docker Compose.
Familiarity with observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, Application Insights or the ELK Stack.
Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines and Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
Good communication skills and a collaborative, ownership-driven mindset.
Good spoken and written English (upper-intermediate or above).
Nice to have
Knowledge of CQRS and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
Experience with MongoDB, including document modelling and aggregation.
Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code, using technologies such as Terraform, Bicep or ARM.
Exposure to a frontend framework such as React, Angular or Vue, including API integration from the client side.
Experience working in polyglot environments, such as Node.js, Python or Java.

jobs.title: [Job-32146] AI Developer - Vaga exclusiva PCD, Brazil

jobs.description:
Na CI&T , ajudamos grandes empresas a transformar o potencial da AI em impacto real nos negócios com AI Deployment, execução AI-native e tech-integrated business solutions.
Com 30 anos de experiência em transformação tecnológica, aceleramos inovação com expertise em agentic SDLC, application modernization, Data & AI, martech e business strategy. 
Somos 8.000 CI&Ters em mais de 25 países, colaborando para construir soluções com impacto real. AI já faz parte da forma como trabalhamos, evoluímos e inovamos todos os dias.
Importante: se você reside na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequencia vigente.


Procuramos uma pessoa AI Engineer apaixonada por engenharia de software de ponta, resolução de problemas complexos e capacitação de times de alta performance.
Nesta posição, você fará parte da Squad Enabling, atuando como pessoa catalisadora da transformação Agentic SDLC em uma das maiores empresas de mobilidade da América Latina.
Se você possui sólida bagagem em engenharia de software, domina arquiteturas agênticas e quer transformar a forma como software é construído em escala, esta oportunidade é para você!
 
Responsabilidades: 
Habilitar processos, instalar capacidades técnicas de engenharia e inteligência artificial nas squads piloto e garantir a evolução contínua da plataforma de desenvolvimento agêntico do cliente, preparando os times para operar com autonomia e alto padrão de qualidade.
Adoção e Habilitação do Framework Agêntico:  Garantir a adoção do ecossistema e ferramentas de IA nas squads piloto, atuando como Advisor e parceiro técnico no dia a dia dos times.
Evolução do Workflow e Plataforma: Atuar em par com os engenheiros do cliente para identificar fricções, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria na solução agêntica, propondo e priorizando o backlog evolutivo do framework.
Co-construção de Soluções Agênticas: Desenvolver e refatorar fluxos agênticos, bundles de agentes e instaciação automatizada de skills e repositórios em parceria com o time local.
Capacitação em Harness Engineering e Evals:Treinar e mentorar desenvolvedores nas melhores práticas do uso de IA, parametrização de Harness Engineering, escrita de critérios de aceite executáveis (Gherkin/DoR) e criação de Evals (avaliações automatizadas).
Instalação de Capabilities e Shift-Left de Qualidade: Instalar e amadurecer capacidades técnicas de engenharia de software nas squads — com foco especial em testes de componente isolados (WireMock e bancos em memória), suítes integradas e validações bloqueantes em CI/CD.
Apoio ao Move to Production (MTP) Agêntico: Apoiar na estruturação e validação de esteiras de deploy automatizado baseadas em pontuação de avaliação de risco automatizada.
Requisitos:
Fundamentos de Engenharia de Software
- Sólida base em *Engenharia de Software
- Profundo conhecimento em princípios de design de software: modularidade, separação de conceitos (separation of concerns), testabilidade, manutenibilidade, resiliência e interfaces limpas.
- Experiência prática com Docker, CI/CD, automação de testes (unitários, componentes e e2e) e controle de versão (Git/GitHub/Azure DevOps).
Engenharia de IA e Arquiteturas Agênticas
- Capacidade comprovada de projetar e entregar soluções de  IA Generativa e LLMs em nível de produção (production-grade).
- Domínio prático de padrões de IA Agêntica e RAG: uso de ferramentas (tool use), function calling, orquestração, fluxos Human-in-the-Loop e guardrails.
- Conhecimento de Agentic SDLC, coding agents, agentes de refatoração/revisão e integração com ferramentas de desenvolvedores.
Conhecimento em sistemas multi-agentes e workflows de execução longa.
- Domínio de estratégias de retrieval (embeddings, busca vetorial, chunking, reranking) e arquiteturas de recuperação de conhecimento corporativo (incluindo familiaridade com Knowledge Graphs ou GraphRAG).
Frameworks, SDKs e Provedores
- Proficiência em frameworks ou SDKs de IA, tais como LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, OpenAI Agents SDK, Strands ou similares.
- Experiência prática com múltiplos provedores de LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, etc.).
Avaliação, Observabilidade e Qualidade (Evals & Ops)
- Domínio de Evals e Observabilidade em IA: métricas de qualidade, rastreamento (tracing), latência, consumo de tokens, análise de falhas e gestão de custos.
Experiência prática com plataformas de observabilidade e métricas como Datadog LLM Observability, LangSmith, OpenTelemetry ou soluções correlatas.
Diferenciais:
- Experiência prévia na atuação como Enabler  ou mentor técnico em processos de transformação digital e adoção de IA em escala.
- Vivência na implantação de práticas de Shift-Left Quality e Quality Built-In em pipelines de CI/CD.
#LI-RR2
Nossos benefícios:
 
- Plano de saúde e odontológico;
- Vale alimentação e refeição;
- Auxílio-creche;
- Licença parental estendida;
- Parceria com academias e profissionais de saúde e bem-estar via Wellhub (Gympass)  TotalPass;
- Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR);
- Seguro de Vida;
- Plataforma de aprendizagem contínua (CI&T University);
- Clube de descontos;
- Plataforma online gratuita dedicada à promoção da saúde física, mental e bem-estar;
- Curso gestante e parentalidade responsável;
- Parceria com plataformas de cursos online;
- Plataforma para aprendizagem de idiomas;
- E muitos outros
 
Mais detalhes sobre os nossos benefícios aqui: https://ciandt.com/br/pt-br/carreiras
 
Na CI&T, a inclusão começa no primeiro contato. Se você é pessoa com deficiência, é importante apresentar o seu laudo durante o processo seletivo. Consulte quais dados são necessários conter no laudo clicando aqui. Assim, podemos garantir o suporte e as adaptações que você merece. Se ainda não tem o laudo caracterizador, não se preocupe: podemos te apoiar para obtê-lo.
 
Temos um time dedicado de Saúde e Bem-estar, especialistas em inclusão e grupos de afinidade que estarão com você em todas as etapas. Conte com a gente para fazer essa jornada lado a lado.

jobs.title: [Job-32140] AI Engineer (Senior Developer Backend Java), Brasil

jobs.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.
With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.
We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.


Main responsibilities
- Define, build, and deliver high-quality, high-performance data pipelines in Azure (ADF, Synapse, Databricks) and, when necessary, on on-premises platforms.
- Ensure continuous support and maintenance of existing data pipelines, including proactive monitoring and handling of complex incident and problem tickets, troubleshooting failures and fixing bugs, proposing and implementing architectural and code improvements.
- Participate in the Data Validation process.
- Ensure that all systems meet the business requirements and the non-functional requirements (performance, security, privacy, GDPR/LGPD).
- Integrate up-and-coming data management and software engineering technologies into existing data structures.
- Analyze and organize raw data, ingest, transform, and make data available in data lakes and data marts.
- Collaborate directly with BI, Data Science, and Software Engineering teams to document and deliver consistent data solutions.
Requirements
- Solid experience in Azure Cloud data ecosystem (focus on ADF, Synapse, Databricks/Spark, ADLS).
- Development of reports (Reporting Services) and dashboards (Power BI).
- Experience in designing, building, and testing data pipelines (ETL/ELT), ensuring performance and reliability.
- Comfort in learning and integrating new frameworks and cloud-native technologies.
- Ability to share your knowledge with more junior team members.
- Knowledge on Microsoft SQL Server tech stack.
- Robust experience in Dimensional Modelling and Strong domain knowledge of SQL for building Data Marts and Data Warehouses.
- Experience in contributing to technical reference, assisting in defining data standards, and participating in code reviews.
- Practical experience in applying Software Engineering principles, including advanced use of Git (branches, PRs) and implementing/maintaining CI/CD for data solutions.
Nice to have
- Knowledge of unit, integration and E2E testing.
- Cloud Certification (Azure or AWS)
- Knowledge of Data Catalog and Lineage processes and tools (e.g., Azure Purview).
- Experience with Python or Scala for scripting and data process automation.
- Experience with Orchestration tools like Airflow.

• Experience implementing or working within a reconciliation/data-quality framework (variance detection, exception handling).
• Solid Git-based development workflow and CI/CD promotion experience (dev → test/UAT → production).
• Fluent English (B2) — daily collaboration with a distributed engineering team and client stakeholders.

Nice to Have:

jobs.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.
With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.
We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.


We are seeking talented Generative AI Engineers to join our team and build AI solutions that transform how our clients leverage artificial intelligence. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of software engineering and AI, designing and implementing sophisticated generative AI systems that go beyond simple API integrations. You'll be responsible for architecting scalable AI applications using cutting-edge platforms (such as AWS Bedrock, Gemini, OpenAI SDK, among others), building RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, implementing agentic architectures, and creating intelligent solutions that drive real business value.
As a Generative AI Engineer, you'll collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, data scientists, solution architects, and other engineers to translate complex business requirements into production-ready AI systems. Your work will directly impact product capabilities, user experience, and our clients' ability to innovate with AI technology.
 
Responsibilities:
AI Solution Development & Architecture
Design, develop, and deploy production-ready applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), including GPT, Gemini, Claude and other foundation models through AWS Bedrock
Build and optimize sophisticated RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures that can process and retrieve information from large-scale document repositories
Implement and orchestrate multi-agent AI systems using AWS Bedrock Agents and AgentCore frameworks
Design scalable AI pipelines that integrate with enterprise systems and maintain performance at production scale
Backend & Infrastructure Development
Develop robust backend services and APIs for AI applications using Python and modern frameworks
Implement containerization and deployment strategies for AI applications
Build monitoring and observability solutions to track AI system performance, quality, and costs
Prompt Engineering & Model Optimization
Design and optimize high-quality prompts and templates that guide LLM behavior and responses
Implement advanced prompt engineering techniques to maximize model performance and accuracy
Evaluate and fine-tune models for specific use cases when appropriate
Continuously experiment with different model configurations, hyperparameters, and architectures
Collaboration & Innovation
Partner with vertical areas and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions
Stay current with the latest advancements in generative AI research and evaluate emerging foundation models
Contribute to technical documentation, best practices, and knowledge sharing within the team
Participate in Sales initiatives related to Generative AI
 
 
Requirements:
Prefered Skills
Strong years of professional software engineering experience
Backend development experience (Full-stack is a differential)
Hands-on experiencewith
Large Language Models (LLMs) and foundation model APIs
Agentic Architecture & Implementation (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen)
Prompt engineering and optimization techniques
Data consumption for agentic with Vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch) and embedding models or Knowledge Graph
Knowledge of DevOps and public cloud practices (Desired CI/CD pipelines for AI applications)
Knowledge of Python with experience in modern frameworks and libraries

jobs.description:

You will co-own a multi-account AWS network foundation: hub and spoke on Transit Gateway, centralised inspection, controlled egress, hybrid connectivity into a client's SD-WAN estate through a third-party vendor. You will be in the room when the client's cloud architect asks why a subnet is a /25 and not a /24 — and the answer has to be yours.
The work is unglamorous in the way that matters. Most of what goes wrong in a landing zone does not go wrong in a module — it goes wrong at the seams. We want someone who has been burned by those and now checks for them by reflex.
Responsabilidades:
Own the network foundation end to end: Transit Gateway with separated inspected and uninspected route tables, VPC design across inspection, egress, ingress, shared services, and workload tiers
Define and enforce the routing posture that makes traffic pass a firewall rather than merely sit near one
Verify that posture by test, not by reading your own plan
Design and implement Transit Gateway Connect over GRE with BGP, two peers for availability, ASNs agreed in advance
Extract precise inputs from third-party SD-WAN vendors who are not on your team and do not share your deadline
Manage AWS IPAM with a delegated organisation administrator, pool hierarchy mapped to accounts, RAM shares to spoke accounts
Justify every prefix — "it looked tidy" is not an answer
Implement AWS Network Firewall with stateful rule groups, default drop posture, domain allowlisting, and managed threat signatures
Be the person who knows whether an application failing to reach the internet is the firewall working correctly
Write and maintain Terraform across multiple accounts with per-phase state separation, deployed through GitHub OIDC
Implement drift detection, static validation, and a pipeline that a client can inherit
Manage log delivery into governance accounts, resource policies, KMS key policies, and service-linked roles
Understand that these accept broken configurations silently — and prove delivery by watching a log arrive
Write down why: why a prefix is what it is, why an option was rejected, what a deviation is
Prevent the next engineer from reversing a deliberate choice because nobody recorded the reasoning
Write down why: why a prefix is what it is, why an option was rejected, what a deviation is
Prevent the next engineer from reversing a deliberate choice because nobody recorded the reasoning
Requisitos:
Transit Gateway: association vs. propagation (no hedging), appliance mode, and why it exists
VPC design: Network Firewall, NAT and egress control, PrivateLink, Route 53 Resolver
Hands-on with hub and spoke and centralised inspection — built it, broke it, and fixed it (non-negotiable)
Ability to describe a routing asymmetry you diagnosed or a firewall you had to prove was in the path
Organizations, Control Tower, OUs, SCPs, delegated administrators, RAM
Experience inheriting a landing zone someone else deployed
Module design, state layout across accounts and phases
Read a plan and know before applying whether you are renaming or destroying a resource
Site-to-site VPN or Direct Connect, GRE, BGP peering, route advertisement, ASN allocation
Default to checking the environment rather than trusting a report — including your own
Every serious problem was found by someone querying the account instead of reading a summary
Clear, precise, unhedged prose — a delivery skill, not a nice-to-have
Inglês Avançado/Fluente é obrigatório
Diferencial:
AWS Advanced Networking Specialty certification — or the equivalent scar tissue
Experience with SD-WAN platforms on AWS (Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto) and Transit Gateway Connect
Exposure to manufacturing or industrial environments
Familiarity with AWS Account Factory for Terraform (AFT)
Working fluency in both Portuguese and English — client conversations in English; team works in Portuguese

Sua missão
Estamos abrindo uma posição de Tech Lead com atuação como AI Engineer dentro de uma operação estratégica dedicada a um cliente do setor financeiro. Este é um papel técnico de nível Sênior, responsável por estruturar soluções de software eficientes, escaláveis e seguras, ao mesmo tempo em que atua como referência no uso de agentes de IA dentro do ciclo de desenvolvimento da squad.
Você é o elo entre a visão arquitetural do Principal Architect e a execução diária dos desenvolvedores — e em um modelo de SDLC agêntico, esse papel ganha uma dimensão extra. Você não só define como o sistema deve ser construído, mas também como os agentes devem ser configurados para construí-lo. Você traduz a arquitetura em contexto para os agentes, valida o que eles produzem e garante que cada componente entregue esteja aderente às diretrizes técnicas da operação.
Stack tecnológica do contexto
- Cloud: AWS como plataforma principal de infraestrutura
- Backend: Java como linguagem central, com foco em microsserviços
- Padrões arquiteturais: BFF (Backend for Frontend), API Gateway, camadas integradoras e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos
- Integrações: APIs REST e proxy, integração com plataformas transacionais de terceiros
- CI/CD: Pipelines de entrega contínua com boas práticas de desenvolvimento agêntico
- Qualidade: Testes unitários, de integração, de performance e revisões de segurança
- Plataforma de IA: Cursor, com agentes cobrindo as etapas de SPEC, DEV, TEST e DEPLOY dentro das squads
O que você vai fazer
- Definir e documentar a arquitetura de software de componentes e domínios da operação, considerando escalabilidade, desempenho, segurança e aderência aos padrões estabelecidos pelo Principal Architect.
- Atuar como AI Engineer da squad, sendo responsável por configurar, alimentar com contexto e evoluir os agentes de IA que participam do ciclo de desenvolvimento, garantindo que operem com as premissas arquiteturais corretas em cada etapa do SDLC.
- Elaborar e manter diagramas, documentação técnica e decisões de arquitetura que sirvam tanto como guia para os desenvolvedores quanto como contexto estruturado para instrução dos agentes de IA.
- Avaliar e selecionar tecnologias, frameworks e padrões apropriados para cada frente de entrega, equilibrando viabilidade técnica, estratégia do projeto e compatibilidade com o modelo agêntico.
- Escrever e refinar prompts técnicos de alta qualidade para orientar agentes nas etapas de especificação, geração de código, criação de testes e documentação, garantindo outputs consistentes e aderentes à arquitetura definida.
- Revisar e validar o código produzido pelos agentes e pelos desenvolvedores, garantindo conformidade com as diretrizes arquiteturais e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
- Identificar riscos técnicos e propor soluções para mitigá-los, antecipando desafios tanto no desenvolvimento humano quanto nos fluxos agênticos.
- Gerenciar o backlog arquitetural, contemplando débitos técnicos, melhorias e evoluções necessárias, priorizando-os no roadmap da squad.
- Garantir que o time possua o conhecimento técnico necessário para o desafio corrente, promovendo alinhamentos, capacitações e documentação acessível.
- Colaborar com o Developer Master no alinhamento técnico diário da squad, atuando como referência para dúvidas de design e implementação.
- Participar de cerimônias ágeis contribuindo com visão técnica no refinamento, planejamento e review das entregas.
O que esperamos de você
- Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software, com domínio de padrões como microsserviços, APIs REST, event-driven architecture, BFF e API Gateway.
- Capacidade de desenhar e documentar soluções técnicas com clareza, produzindo diagramas e registros de decisão que orientem tanto desenvolvedores quanto agentes de IA.
- Experiência com cloud AWS, incluindo boas práticas de deploy, escalabilidade e segurança de aplicações.
- Vivência em pipelines de CI/CD e práticas de DevOps aplicadas ao ciclo de entrega de software.
- Capacidade de realizar revisões de código e garantir a aderência às diretrizes arquiteturais da operação.
- Visão sistêmica para identificar riscos técnicos e propor soluções antes que se tornem impedimentos.
- Boa comunicação com perfis técnicos e não técnicos, com capacidade de alinhar expectativas e comunicar decisões arquiteturais com clareza.
- Inglês técnico para consumo de documentação técnica e escrita de prompts de instrução para agentes de IA.
- Vivência com ferramentas agênticas de desenvolvimento como Claude Code, GitHub Copilot ou Cursor, com capacidade de estabelecer guardrails arquiteturais para o uso seguro e eficiente dessas ferramentas dentro de uma squad.
- Familiaridade com plataformas de GenAI voltadas a fluxos de engenharia de software.
Diferenciais
- Experiência prática como AI Engineer, com vivência real na configuração, operação e evolução de agentes de IA em fluxos de desenvolvimento de software, especialmente nas etapas de especificação, geração de código e validação automatizada.

jobs.description:
Posição na esteiraPonta a ponta, governança da esteira
Atravessa toda a cadeia, do upstream ao downstream. Nao ocupa uma etapa, orquestra
o fluxo inteiro, coordenando pessoas e agentes ao longo da esteira e fazendo a ponte
entre o upstream e a entrega.

Descrição do perfilOrquestrar a entrega de ponta a ponta, mapeando e governando o fluxo de valor (Value
Stream) do SDLC e coordenando workflows entre pessoas e agentes em colaboracao ao
longo de toda a esteira para garantir prazo, custo e qualidade. Responde pela definição,
revisao e evolucao dos processos, padroes e rituais de entrega: como se entrega, como
se gere o time, como se garante compliance e como se mantem a saude do fluxo de
trabalho (workflow health), mantendo o modelo de trabalho consistente e em melhoria
continua. Faz a ponte entre o upstream e a execucao tecnica de Al Engineer e Al
Deployment Engineer, traduzindo a demanda de forma a garantir a viabilidade financeira
e tecnica da solucão, definindo metricas de sucesso (ROI, taxas de acerto) e priorizando
o que gera mais valor na entrega, com fluencia sistemica em IA para governar
dependências, exceções, fluxos de autonomia e limites de aprovação humana.
Desenvolve a fluencia em IA e a constante capacitacao do time, engajando a squad a
sustentar o novo modelo de trabalho em que se orquestra agentes em vez de acumular
especializações.

jobs.title: [Job 31331] Mid Level Fullstack (Java + Angular)  Developer, Brazil

jobs.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.
With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.
We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.


Our client's Digital Supply Chain Analytics team is scaling how artificial intelligence and modern data platforms support day-to-day decisions across manufacturing, logistics, planning, procurement, and operations. The team is running multiple parallel initiatives — from data pipelines feeding AI agents, to a full SaaS replacement for forecasting and inventory management, to machine learning for vision and forecasting systems — and needs additional hands-on developers to keep pace.
The Senior Data Developer joins an existing team and contributes to established code repositories, with work scoped to the individual's strongest skills — whether that's database and pipeline development, application and UI development, or machine learning. Rather than owning a fixed set of responsibilities end to end, this person becomes part of a larger team accountable for the overall project, picking up the pieces of work best suited to their profile. What matters most is the ability to work confidently inside an existing codebase, follow solid Git practices, and communicate clearly and consistently with the rest of the team.

Responsibilities:
Contributes to existing code repositories by extending and maintaining code according to established patterns and conventions.
Follows Git best practices, including branching, commit hygiene, code review, and merge processes.
Communicates progress, blockers, and technical decisions clearly and consistently with the broader team.
Collaborates within a larger cross-functional team accountable for the overall success of each project.

Data Pipelines & Integration  
Builds data pipelines that feed downstream applications, including AI agents that manage purchase orders, by integrating and transforming data from sources such as Google BigQuery and SAP.
Develops and maintains ETL/ELT (Extract, Transform, Load / Extract, Load, Transform) processes to ensure reliable, accurate data flow between systems.
Designs and maintains database structures that support operational and analytical workloads.

Application & UI Development  
Builds and extends front-end interfaces for internal applications, including a SaaS replacement for forecasting and inventory management.
Develops backend features and administrative functionality that support day-to-day application operations.
Builds and maintains scheduled jobs (cron jobs) that automate recurring application or data processes.

Machine Learning  
Supports the development of machine learning models for use cases such as computer vision and forecasting.
Assists in preparing data and features required to train and evaluate models.

Requirements:
Demonstrated experience contributing to and extending existing code repositories in a team environment
Strong working knowledge of Git and collaborative version control practices
Clear, consistent communication skills, comfortable working closely with a distributed team
Depth in at least one of the following areas, with working familiarity in others: database development and SQL, front-end/application development, ETL and data pipeline development, or machine learning
Comfort working across a range of tasks as scoped by the team, rather than a single fixed role
Experience with Google BigQuery, SAP, or similar enterprise data platforms is a plus where relevant to assigned tasks

Nice to Have:
Experience with SAP integrations
Experience building or maintaining SaaS-style applications (forecasting, inventory management, or similar)
Experience with machine learning for computer vision or time-series forecasting
Experience with scheduled/automated jobs (cron) and lightweight administrative tooling
Experience in supply chain, manufacturing, logistics, or procurement contexts

Success in this position depends on the ability to navigate between technical and business priorities, translate client needs into practical solutions, and maintain close alignment with CI&T's broader data practice.

Technical Leadership: Lead the team technically, enabling data scientists and data developers to build, enhance, and maintain data products across the engagement.
Architecture & Design: Participate in design and architecture discussions, defining solutions that follow security and performance best practices.
Solution Strategy: Understand business and technical requirements and translate them into viable technical solutions by selecting appropriate frameworks and approaches.
Stakeholder Alignment: Communicate directly with client team members to align technical solutions with business needs, balancing perspectives from technical leadership (focused on foundational work) and business leadership (focused on solving practical problems).
Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with strategy, customer experience, product, and non-technical program management teams to ensure solutions serve broader business goals.
Delivery Environment: Guarantee a stable and productive development environment for the team.
Data Assessment: Participate in data assessments and complex data modernization engagements, identifying priorities that deliver incremental value.
Practice Connection: Maintain direct connection with CI&T's data practice, contributing to and drawing on shared expertise across projects and clients.
Multi-market Delivery: Work across a variety of projects, clients, and subject-matter domains in coordination with teams in Mexico, North America, Brazil, and other Latin American countries.

Advanced/Fluent English (C1 or above)

Solid experience in data architecture design and technical leadership
Solid experience designing, developing, and deploying pipelines, data lakes, data meshes, and other data products
Experience with cloud data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, or similar);
Experience with data pipeline orchestration and workflow automation
Solid experience translating business problems into data solutions
Nice to Have:
Experience with consultative data assessments and data modernization engagements
Knowledge of Data Governance principles
Experience with CI/CD and MLOps pipelines
Experience collaborating with pre-sales, presenting data solutions to non-technical audiences
Ability to build proof of concepts and prototype complex technical mechanisms
Experience scaling data workloads
Familiarity with AI engagements and agentic coding
Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

At CI&T, our rapid growth is fueled by the innovative solutions we create for our global clients. We are seeking a Security & Privacy Governance Lead to own sensitive-data classification, masking, and governance design for a large-scale Finance data platform modernization at a major US mortgage lender, working alongside the Principal Data Architect to turn the target architecture's governance requirements into implemented policy. This role leads the classification and masking design work during the program's design-validation phase, because that work gates everything the development team builds afterward.
This position combines hands-on policy implementation with cross-functional coordination: the professional designs classification, masking, and access-tiering rules directly in the platform, defines how standardized business metrics are governed across the data estate, and partners with client security and compliance stakeholders to secure sign-off before build begins.
Responsibilities 
Lead sensitive-data classification across the source system's tables and dimension values, producing accurate, defensible classification output.
Design dynamic data masking policies and row-access policies on sensitive financial fields (general ledger and payroll-adjacent), scoped by role and business unit.
Define the raw-vs-curated access tiering and least-privilege access model across the data platform.
Design column-level lineage from source through landing, staging, conformed, and curated layers, the semantic model, and into consuming reports — auditable end to end.
Support master data management (MDM) efforts to ensure standardized, consistent definitions of key business metrics (such as billing and financial figures) across the platform.
Deliver governance artifacts platform-neutrally: policy objects/tags implemented directly in the platform, plus versioned, documented classification and lineage artifacts in client-controlled repositories.
Partner with client Security, Privacy, and Compliance teams to secure design approval ahead of build, and resolve open questions on network/identity boundary decisions that touch sensitive data.
Support downstream integration of classification and lineage artifacts into the client's own enterprise catalog/governance tooling, without building or operating that tooling directly.
 
Requirements or this challenge:
Solid experience in data security/privacy governance roles on enterprise data platforms, including hands-on policy implementation, not policy-writing alone.
Experience implementing data classification, dynamic masking, and row-access/row-level security on a modern cloud data warehouse (Snowflake preferred).
Experience designing or contributing to column-level lineage across multi-layer data pipelines.
Working knowledge of data privacy and access-governance practice in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare, or similar).
Comfortable leading the classification and masking design during a design-validation phase, where your output directly gates the rest of the build.
Fluent English (C1) — direct engagement with client Security, Privacy, and Compliance stakeholders and gate reviews.
 
Nice to Have
Experience with Microsoft Fabric/OneLake governance boundaries alongside Snowflake.
Experience in mortgage, lending, or financial-services data governance.
Familiarity with constraining AI-assisted development tools to metadata/aggregate access only, never raw sensitive values.

At CI&T, our rapid growth is fueled by the innovative solutions we create for our global clients. We are seeking a hands-on Principal Data Architect to own the target architecture for a large-scale data platform modernization at a major US mortgage lender — migrating Finance reporting off a legacy on-premises source system onto a governed cloud data platform (Azure, Microsoft Fabric, and Snowflake), with CDC-based replication and a certified BI semantic layer. This is deliberately a hands-on role: you build alongside the development team through design and build, not a review-from-a-distance seat.
This position calls for a hybrid architect: someone who can design and defend complex technical decisions in front of the client's data and cloud teams at a strategic level, while also working hands-on with the development team to validate and build the solution. A strong grounding in software and data development is essential — profiles limited to analytics work alone will not have the depth this role requires.
Responsibilities
Own the end-to-end target architecture spanning CDC replication, lakehouse landing (Fabric/OneLake), and a layered cloud data warehouse (raw/staging → conformed → curated) on Snowflake.
Author and maintain architecture decision records covering transformation mechanism, CDC/load strategy, semantic-model storage mode, warehouse isolation, and cross-platform (lakehouse-to-warehouse) interoperability.
Design the curated data layer and dimensional model, including recomputing source-system runtime-calculated values that don't exist in raw replicated data, and conforming key-value dimension structures into standard reporting attributes.
Design the strategy for a single certified BI semantic model consumed by all downstream reporting tools, with metric definitions versioned in one governed place.
Work hands-on inside the codebase alongside the development team through the design-and-build core.
Lead technical discovery with client architecture, security, and platform teams; resolve open interoperability and network/identity design questions.
Own quality gates for architecture decisions — design validation, baseline lock, cutover readiness — and produce the evidence client stakeholders need to sign off.
Mentor the development team on transformation patterns, incremental materialization, and reconciliation/data-quality design.
Requirements for this challenge 
Solid experience in data architecture, including hands-on delivery (not review-only) on enterprise data platform modernization programs.
Proven experience architecting cloud data platforms on Snowflake, including layered raw/staging/curated models and incremental transformation patterns (e.g., dynamic or materialized tables).
Experience with Microsoft Fabric/OneLake, or a comparable lakehouse platform, including cross-platform interoperability between a lakehouse and a cloud data warehouse.
Experience architecting change-data-capture (CDC) based replication pipelines (e.g., Qlik Replicate, Fivetran, Debezium, or similar) from a relational source into a cloud platform.
Experience designing governed, certified BI semantic layers (Power BI or equivalent) consumed by multiple reporting tools.
Strong command of data governance fundamentals: classification, masking, row-level access, lineage.
Fluent English (C1) — direct engagement with client architecture, security, and executive stakeholders.
 
Nice to Have
Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or another ERP as a source system for financial/GL reporting.
Experience in mortgage, lending, or broader financial-services data platforms.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development toolchains inside a governed software development lifecycle (SDLC), where AI output is always a draft requiring human sign-off on production logic.

As CI&T grows its Data & Analytics Center of Excellence, we seek a talented and experienced Graph Database Developer to join a specialized team building an AI-powered fashion advisory platform for a leading client in the fashion and retail industry. This role is central to turning unstructured editorial content into a structured knowledge graph that powers real-time, intelligent style recommendations for end users attending formal events.
The Graph Database Developer will work in a staff augmentation model, integrating with a cross-functional team that includes a Machine Learning Developer and a GenAI Agent Developer. This is a hands-on technical position requiring strong ownership of the graph data layer — from schema design through ingestion, entity resolution, and query performance — with direct impact on what the AI agent recommends to users.
Responsibilities:
Schema Design: Define node labels and edge types that represent the relationships between designers, garments, style attributes, trends, occasions, and editorial articles.
Entity Ingestion: Build workflows that consume structured JSON payloads from the upstream data pipeline and load them into the graph database in batch mode.
Probabilistic Entity Matching: Match extracted item mentions (for example, a bag described by type, color, and material) to the correct product node in a catalog of 50,000+ SKUs by scoring attribute overlap, assigning a match confidence, and creating the relationship only when it exceeds a defined threshold. Deduplicate items that appear inconsistently across different articles.
Editorial Signal Weighting: Assign weights to relationships based on how prominently an item or trend was featured, distinguishing a dedicated feature from a passing mention. These weights determine what the AI agent surfaces first in its recommendations.
Query Optimization: Design and tune openCypher traversal queries, including multi-hop queries, to return relevant results in under three seconds for downstream Amazon Bedrock Agents.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside the Machine Learning Developer and GenAI Agent Developer to align the graph structure with the retrieval and recommendation needs of the AI agent.
Technical Validation: Support technical interviews and validation of new team members joining the graph database workstream, as needed.
Requirements:
Advanced English proficiency (C1 or above), with autonomy to communicate directly with international stakeholders
Solid experience with the property graph data model
Experience writing and optimizing openCypher queries, including multi-hop traversals under latency constraints
Experience designing graph schemas, evaluating trade-offs between different modeling approaches
Experience building entity resolution logic, including fuzzy matching, scoring algorithms, and deduplication across data sources
Strong Python skills for data engineering, including batch processing of structured data payloads
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, staff augmentation setting with an established client team
 
Nice to Have:
Solid experience with Amazon Neptune
Prior experience in fashion, retail, or e-commerce catalogs
AWS certification in databases or data analytics
Experience integrating graph databases with generative AI agents (for example, Amazon Bedrock Agents)

jobs.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.
With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.
We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.


As CI&T grows its Data & Analytics Center of Excellence, we seek a talented and experienced Graph Database Developer to join a specialized team building an AI-powered fashion advisory platform for a leading client in the fashion and retail industry. This role is central to turning unstructured editorial content into a structured knowledge graph that powers real-time, intelligent style recommendations for end users attending formal events.
The Graph Database Developer will work in a staff augmentation model, integrating with a cross-functional team that includes a Machine Learning Developer and a GenAI Agent Developer. This is a hands-on technical position requiring strong ownership of the graph data layer — from schema design through ingestion, entity resolution, and query performance — with direct impact on what the AI agent recommends to users.
Responsibilities:
Schema Design: Define node labels and edge types that represent the relationships between designers, garments, style attributes, trends, occasions, and editorial articles.
Entity Ingestion: Build workflows that consume structured JSON payloads from the upstream data pipeline and load them into the graph database in batch mode.
Probabilistic Entity Matching: Match extracted item mentions (for example, a bag described by type, color, and material) to the correct product node in a catalog of 50,000+ SKUs by scoring attribute overlap, assigning a match confidence, and creating the relationship only when it exceeds a defined threshold. Deduplicate items that appear inconsistently across different articles.
Editorial Signal Weighting: Assign weights to relationships based on how prominently an item or trend was featured, distinguishing a dedicated feature from a passing mention. These weights determine what the AI agent surfaces first in its recommendations.
Query Optimization: Design and tune openCypher traversal queries, including multi-hop queries, to return relevant results in under three seconds for downstream Amazon Bedrock Agents.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside the Machine Learning Developer and GenAI Agent Developer to align the graph structure with the retrieval and recommendation needs of the AI agent.
Technical Validation: Support technical interviews and validation of new team members joining the graph database workstream, as needed.
Requirements:
Advanced English proficiency (C1 or above), with autonomy to communicate directly with international stakeholders
Solid experience with the property graph data model
Experience writing and optimizing openCypher queries, including multi-hop traversals under latency constraints
Experience designing graph schemas, evaluating trade-offs between different modeling approaches
Experience building entity resolution logic, including fuzzy matching, scoring algorithms, and deduplication across data sources
Strong Python skills for data engineering, including batch processing of structured data payloads
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, staff augmentation setting with an established client team
 
Nice to Have:
Solid experience with Amazon Neptune
Prior experience in fashion, retail, or e-commerce catalogs
AWS certification in databases or data analytics
Experience integrating graph databases with generative AI agents (for example, Amazon Bedrock Agents)
Familiarity with recommendation systems or ranking/weighting logic for content surfacing

Com o propósito de levar emoção à vida das pessoas, a La Moda busca profissionais que têm metas arrojadas e sonham alto, que são obcecados pelos detalhes em busca da perfeição, que admiram a inteligência de quem quer aprender sempre, que envolvem as pessoas para criar coesão e que todos os dias fazem o trivial de um jeito diferente, surpreendendo, pois têm a ousadia de ir além.Todas as nossas vagas também são dedicadas para pessoas com deficiência. Responsabilidades e atribuiçõesResponsável por desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações, garantindo a qualidade, performance, segurança e escalabilidade das soluções. Atua na construção e integração de APIs, modelagem e consumo de bancos de dados, implementação de novas funcionalidades e sustentação dos sistemas existentes, contribuindo para a estabilidade e evolução dos produtos digitais da empresa.Trabalha em parceria com equipes multidisciplinares, como Produto, UX/UI, Dados e demais desenvolvedores, participando da análise de requisitos, definição de soluções técnicas, revisão de código e melhoria contínua dos processos de desenvolvimento.
